headline: Count of write-in votes for mayor from the November 3, 2026 general election.
summary: The meeting will count write-in votes cast for mayor. Residents can also give public input, and email testimony is accepted until 9:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting.
items: Count of write-in votes cast for mayor in the November 3, 2026 general election
location: Room 303, Pawtucket City Hall, 137 Roosevelt Ave., Pawtucket, RI
